newsitem.title: FRANCE: HORSE RACING-VEREVA WINS FRENCH OAKS FOR AGA KHAN.
newsitem.headline: HORSE RACING-VEREVA WINS FRENCH OAKS FOR AGA KHAN.

text.p: Vereva, ridden by Gerald Mosse for the Aga Khan, won the French Oaks horse racing classic on Sunday.
Vereva took up the running with 200 metres to go from pacesetting Ryafan, the mount of Frankie Dettori, and held on readily from the fast-finishing Mousse Glacee.
Third place in the 12-strong field went to the favourite Brilliance, ridden by Sylvain Guillot.
A stewards' inquiry was ordered but it did not seem to involve the winner who enjoyed a trouble-free run on the outside.
